source: Assembled from the Phase AI research notes (mechanics, September 2026). Limits and menu names change; the page tells people to trust the counter and the labels in their own assistant. AI.12c re-checks each destination and records smoke results here.

destinations.label: ChatGPT custom instructions
destinations.limit_note: Free plans have allowed about 1,500 characters per box. Paid plans were reported raised to 5,000 in July 2026 (secondary source, not verified). Trust the counter in your own box.
install: Open ChatGPT and go to Settings, then Personalization, then Custom instructions.
Paste the notes into the box for how you want ChatGPT to respond. On a free plan use the short notes.
Save, then start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open Settings, then Personalization, then Custom instructions.
Delete the notes from the box and save.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, also review Settings, Personalization, Memory, and delete any saved item that describes you.

destinations.label: ChatGPT Project
destinations.limit_note: The limit for project instructions is not verified. The long notes are written to fit 5,000 characters.
install: In ChatGPT, open Projects and create a project for this use, for example one for study.
Open the project's instructions and paste the notes.
Start your chats inside that project so they use the notes.
remove: Open the project and clear its instructions, or delete the project.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Settings, Personalization, Memory, and delete any saved item that describes you.

destinations.label: Claude preferences
destinations.limit_note: No limit is documented for Claude's account-wide instructions. The short notes fit anywhere.
install: Open Claude and go to Settings. Find the personal instructions (called instructions for Claude, or personal preferences).
Paste the notes there and save.
Start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open Settings and find the personal instructions.
Delete the notes and save.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Claude's memory settings and delete any saved item that describes you.

destinations.label: Claude Project
destinations.limit_note: The long notes are written to fit 5,000 characters. Free plans allow a small number of projects.
install: In Claude, open Projects and create a project for this use, for example one for study.
Open the project's instructions and paste the notes.
Start your chats inside that project so they use the notes.
remove: Open the project and clear its instructions, or delete the project.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Claude's memory settings and delete any saved item that describes you.

destinations.label: Gemini instructions
destinations.limit_note: The limit is not verified. The short notes are the safe choice.
install: Open Gemini and go to Settings, then find Instructions for Gemini (saved info).
Add the notes and save.
Start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open Settings and find Instructions for Gemini (saved info).
Delete the notes and save.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Gemini's saved info and past chats settings, and delete anything that describes you.

destinations.label: Gemini Gem
destinations.limit_note: The limit for a Gem's instructions is not verified. The long notes are written to fit 5,000 characters.
install: In Gemini, open Gems and create a new Gem for this use.
Paste the notes into the Gem's instructions and save.
Start your chats with that Gem so they use the notes.
remove: Open the Gem and clear its instructions, or delete the Gem.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Gemini's saved info settings, and delete anything that describes you.

destinations.label: Microsoft Copilot
destinations.limit_note: The limit is not verified. The short notes are the safe choice.
install: Open Copilot and go to Settings, then Personalization, then custom instructions.
Paste the notes and save.
Start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open Settings, Personalization, custom instructions, and delete the notes.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, review Copilot's saved memories and delete any that describe you.

destinations.label: Claude Code skill (recommended for coding agents)
destinations.limit_note: A skill loads only when you ask for an explanation or teaching, so the notes stay out of the way the rest of the time.
install: Download the file. Your browser saves it to your Downloads folder under the name shown below. If it saved under a different name, for example with (1) added, use that name.
Open a terminal and run the commands for your computer. They move the file into place and stop without changing anything if a file is already there.
Start a new Claude Code session. The skill loads when you ask to be taught or given an explanation.
remove: Open a terminal and run the removal commands for your computer.
If you ever pasted the notes into a chat message, also review the memory of that assistant and delete anything that describes you.

destinations.label: Claude Code personal rules file
destinations.limit_note: A personal rules file applies in every project on this computer. It is never a file inside a repository.
install: Download the file. Your browser saves it to your Downloads folder under the name shown below. If it saved under a different name, for example with (1) added, use that name.
Open a terminal and run the commands for your computer. They move the file into place and stop without changing anything if a file is already there.
Start a new Claude Code session.
remove: Open a terminal and run the removal commands for your computer.

destinations.label: Codex personal instructions
destinations.limit_note: This is your own file in your home folder, never a file inside a repository.
install: Open the file ~/.codex/AGENTS.md in a text editor. If it does not exist, create it.
Paste the notes at the end of the file. Never replace the file: it may already hold other instructions.
Save, then start a new Codex session.
remove: Open ~/.codex/AGENTS.md in a text editor.
Delete the block that starts with the line How I like explanations, through the end of the notes, and save.

destinations.label: Gemini CLI personal instructions
destinations.limit_note: This is your own file in your home folder, never a file inside a repository.
install: Open the file ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md in a text editor. If it does not exist, create it.
Paste the notes at the end of the file. Never replace the file: it may already hold other instructions.
Save, then start a new Gemini CLI session.
remove: Open ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md in a text editor.
Delete the block that starts with the line How I like explanations, through the end of the notes, and save.

destinations.label: Cursor user rules
destinations.limit_note: Use your personal (user) rules, never the project rules of a shared repository.
install: Open Cursor's settings and find Rules, then your user rules (personal, not project rules).
Paste the notes and save.
Start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open Cursor's settings, Rules, your user rules, and delete the notes.

destinations.label: GitHub Copilot personal instructions
destinations.limit_note: Use your personal instructions, never a file inside a shared repository: collaborators and the history would see it.
install: Open your GitHub Copilot settings and find your personal custom instructions.
Paste the notes and save.
Start a new chat to check that the notes are used.
remove: Open your GitHub Copilot settings, personal custom instructions, and delete the notes.

destinations.label: Your own app (JSON)
destinations.limit_note: The JSON mirrors the long notes line for line. It carries no numbers.
install: Download the JSON file.
Read it in your own tool and treat it as instructions for wording and depth only.
remove: Delete the file from wherever you stored it.

destinations.label: Just for me

install: Read the notes, copy them, or download them.
